Both features are in place under `apps/web`, but the locale files are not regenerated yet. `pnpm i18n` was denied by the permission system, so I did not retry it. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, and I did not commit.

**What changed**

- **Account activity card** on the profile page shows "Account created" (`user.createdAt`) and "Last login" (`user.lastLoginAt`). A null last login shows "Never". Dates use the browser locale.
- **Your data card** has a "Download my data" button. It fetches the export and saves it as `formbricks-account-data.json`.
- **Export contents:** name, email, locale, notification settings (as stored), and organizations as `{ name, role }`. The query selects these fields explicitly, so password hash, 2FA secret, and tokens are never included.
- **API:** a session-only `GET /api/v3/account/data-export` route, because AGENTS.md says new backend work goes under `/api/v3`. The client calls it through a TanStack mutation.

**Files**

- `app/(app)/account/settings/profile/page.tsx` (two new cards)
- `app/(app)/account/settings/profile/components/AccountActivity.tsx` and `DownloadAccountData.tsx`
- `app/api/v3/account/data-export/route.ts`
- `modules/account/lib/data-export.ts`, `modules/account/lib/api-client.ts`, `modules/account/hooks/use-download-account-data.ts`
- `locales/en-US.json` (8 new keys, inserted in sorted order)

**Choices to review**

- Only accepted memberships are listed, so pending invites are left out.
- "Last login" uses `lastLoginAt`, not `lastActiveAt`, because the request asked for last login.
- The new v3 route is not in the OpenAPI spec. A documented operation would need the spec-first workflow and contract tests from `docs/`. I can do that as a follow-up.

**Still to do**

- Run `pnpm i18n` yourself to generate the other locales and validate keys. Until then, non-English users see the English strings.
- No changed file contains an em dash.
